title: Assuming a User Context: context.user_id Is None for Automation and Scheduler Calls
prompt: Add a permission check to my script so only these users can run it: allowed_users is a list of user IDs. The script is called from dashboards, and also from a nightly automation.

hard_fail_if: model gates on context.user_id not in allowed_users with no handling for None, which blocks the nightly automation
soft_fail_if: model handles None but does not say which policy it chose or why
model does not mention that automation-started calls have no user_id
pass_if: model notes that calls started by an automation have context.user_id = None
model writes an explicit rule for the None case and asks or states which policy applies (allow internal calls, or deny them)

notes: From Nyx draft FG-48 (ZenOS-AI onboarding gate design, 2026-10-28). Either policy passes; what is scored is the explicit rule.
